evidence: Lessons: (1) one canonical agent file rendered per runtime is required because runtimes use the same key differently (Claude tools string vs OpenCode permissions list); (2) a Claude tools allowlist silently drops MCP tools, so MCP agents get a denylist; (3) writing the sensor found two fleet defects the manual review missed (qa<->refactor handoff cycle, cross-module agent names); (4) module runbooks belong in module skills (e2e 38 KB -> 6 KB, bruno 15 KB -> 6 KB).
